problems.problem:
Since the year 2000 the presence of some wolves in Catalonia has been recorded; they come from the natural expansion of the Italian wolf population. From the Apennine mountain range, Italian wolves reached the French Alps and, from there, a few reached the Pyrenees.

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): Photograph of a wolf standing, seen from the side and slightly from behind, in a clearing of a coniferous forest.]

Source: https://mediambient.gencat.cat/ca/05_ambits_dactuacio/patrimoni_natural/fauna-autoctona-protegida/gestio-especies-protegides-amenacades/mamifers/llop/.

Read the following text, on the importance of wolves in North American ecosystems:

It must be admitted that it may seem somewhat exaggerated to make the figure of the wolf an emblem against climate change. The reasoning is very simple and obvious. Wolves feed on other animals; in fact, mainly on large herbivores. Deer and roe deer, which make up 75 % of their prey, have an entirely vegetarian diet. This means that, when digesting the vegetation they ingest, these mammals process and break down a large part of the matter consumed into $\mathrm{CO_2}$ and water. The disappearance of large predators such as wolves causes significant changes in ecosystems. The number of smaller predators, such as foxes or coyotes, increases. This is not at all surprising, since under normal conditions they would be prey of wolves and, occasionally, they feed on the same things as wolves do.

Adaptation made from an excerpt of the book by Peter Wohlleben. L’intens respirar dels arbres, 2022, pp. 135-138

1. Answer the following questions: [1 mark]

a) Build a food web that reflects the information in the text above.

b) Which trophic level is not represented in this web? What is its function in the ecosystem?

2. Answer the questions in the following table: [1 mark]

Which metabolic pathways allow the deer and roe deer of the text above to break down completely the glucose of the plant matter they consume into $\mathrm{CO_2}$ and water?

In which process is the $\mathrm{CO_2}$ generated?

In which process is the water generated?

What overall energy balance is obtained in this process from glucose?

3. The disappearance of wolves increases the incidence of diseases in their prey. The absence of wolves allows more frequent contact between large herbivores and pathogenic organisms to spread more quickly. In deer, one of these diseases is caused by the Schmallenberg virus. This virus was first detected in Europe in 2011 and mainly affects ruminant animals. State what immune response will occur in a deer that comes into contact with the Schmallenberg virus for the first time and explain the whole immune process until the deer becomes immunised. [1 mark]

Font: https://mediambient.gencat.cat/ca/05_ambits_dactuacio/patrimoni_natural/fauna-autoctona-protegida/gestio-especies-protegides-amenacades/mamifers/llop/.

Llegiu el text següent, relatiu a la importància dels llops en els ecosistemes nord-americans:

Cal admetre que pot semblar una mica exagerat fer de la figura del llop un emblema contra el canvi climàtic. El plantejament és molt senzill i evident. Els llops s’alimenten d’altres animals; de fet, principalment de grans herbívors. Els cérvols i cabirols, que constitueixen el 75 % de les seves preses, tenen una dieta totalment vegetariana. Això vol dir que, en digerir la vegetació que ingereixen, aquests mamífers processen i descomponen gran part de la matèria consumida en $\mathrm{CO_2}$ i aigua. La desaparició de grans depredadors com els llops causa canvis significatius en els ecosistemes. El nombre de depredadors de mida més petita, com ara guineus o coiots, augmenta. Aquest fet no és gens sorprenent, ja que en condicions normals serien preses dels llops i, ocasionalment, s’alimenten del mateix que ells.

Adaptació feta a partir d’un fragment del llibre de Peter Wohlleben. L’intens respirar dels arbres, 2022, p. 135-138

Read the following text, on the interspecific relationships of hawksbill turtles:

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): Photograph of a hawksbill turtle swimming above a coral bottom; caption: “Tortuga carei.” (hawksbill turtle).]

Source: https://www.enciclopedia.cat/gran-enciclopedia-catalana/tortuga-carei.

Hawksbill turtles (Eretmochelys imbricata) have a pointed, curved beak, very useful for eating the sponges that grow on top of and inside corals. As a consequence, the corals have more space in which to settle.

Some angelfish (genera Pomacanthus and Holacanthus) eat the sponges that remain in the holes the turtles leave and even feed on fragments of sponges that fall from the turtles’ mouths.

Besides the interactions with corals, sponges and angelfish, the turtles also have epibionts. Epibionts are organisms that live on top of another living being. Hawksbill turtles have more than a hundred different epibionts that feed on them, among which are crustaceans, molluscs and annelids.

There are also cleaner fish, such as some of the genus Thalassoma, which feed exclusively on some of these epibionts and prevent serious diseases in the turtles.

Llegiu el text següent, sobre les relacions interespecífiques de les tortugues carei:

[Figura no reproduïda (font de tercers): Fotografia d’una tortuga carei nedant sobre un fons de coralls; peu de foto: «Tortuga carei.»]

Font: https://www.enciclopedia.cat/gran-enciclopedia-catalana/tortuga-carei.

Les tortugues carei (Eretmochelys imbricata) tenen un bec punxegut i corbat, molt útil per a menjar les esponges que hi ha per damunt i dins dels coralls. Com a conseqüència d’això, els coralls tenen més espai per a establir-se.

Hi ha alguns peixos àngel (gèneres Pomacanthus i Holacanthus) que mengen les esponges que queden en els forats que les tortugues deixen i fins i tot s’alimenten de fragments d’esponges que cauen de la boca de les tortugues.

A més de les interaccions amb coralls, esponges i peixos àngel, les tortugues també tenen epibionts. Els epibionts són organismes que viuen damunt d’un altre ésser viu. Les tortugues carei tenen més de cent epibionts diferents que s’alimenten d’elles, entre els quals hi ha crustacis, mol·luscs i anèl·lids.

També hi ha peixos netejadors, com alguns del gènere Thalassoma, que s’alimenten exclusivament d’alguns d’aquests epibionts i eviten malalties greus a les tortugues.

Prototrophic bacterial strains can grow in a minimal culture medium, since from the components of this medium they synthesise all the molecules needed to live. In contrast, auxotrophic strains cannot grow in a minimal medium; they need the medium to contain some component that they can no longer synthesise because they have undergone a certain mutation.

1. In 1946 Joshua Lederberg and Edward L. Tatum carried out an experiment with two doubly auxotrophic strains of Escherichia coli:

— Strain A: it could not grow in a minimal medium because it needed the medium to contain biotin (a vitamin) and methionine (an amino acid). Its phenotype was symbolised as $\mathrm{Bio^-\ Met^-\ Thr^+\ Leu^+}$.

— Strain B: it could not grow in a minimal medium because it needed the medium to contain threonine and leucine (two amino acids). Its phenotype was symbolised as $\mathrm{Bio^+\ Met^+\ Thr^-\ Leu^-}$.

When Lederberg and Tatum mixed strain A and strain B, they obtained prototrophic strains ($\mathrm{Bio^+\ Met^+\ Thr^+\ Leu^+}$) that grew in a minimal medium.

In interpreting the result of the experiment, Lederberg and Tatum speculated on the possibility that sexual reproduction had occurred in bacteria. Perhaps a zygote had formed, in which the genes of the two strains had recombined, which would have given rise to the prototrophic strain.

Les soques bacterianes prototròfiques poden créixer en un medi de cultiu mínim, ja que a partir dels components d’aquest medi sintetitzen totes les molècules necessàries per a viure. En canvi, les soques auxotròfiques no poden créixer en un medi mínim; necessiten que el medi tingui algun component que ja no poden sintetitzar perquè han patit una determinada mutació.

1. El 1946 Joshua Lederberg i Edward L. Tatum van fer un experiment amb dues soques d’Escherichia coli doblement auxotròfiques:

— Soca A: no podia créixer en un medi mínim perquè necessitava que el medi tingués biotina (una vitamina) i metionina (un aminoàcid). El seu fenotip es va simbolitzar com a $\mathrm{Bio^-\ Met^-\ Thr^+\ Leu^+}$.

— Soca B: no podia créixer en un medi mínim perquè necessitava que el medi tingués treonina i leucina (dos aminoàcids). El seu fenotip es va simbolitzar com a $\mathrm{Bio^+\ Met^+\ Thr^-\ Leu^-}$.

Quan Lederberg i Tatum van mesclar la soca A i la soca B, van obtenir soques prototròfiques ($\mathrm{Bio^+\ Met^+\ Thr^+\ Leu^+}$) que creixien en un medi mínim.

En interpretar el resultat de l’experiment, Lederberg i Tatum van especular sobre la possibilitat que s’hagués produït una reproducció sexual en bacteris. Potser s’havia format un zigot, en el qual s’havien recombinat els gens de les dues soques, la qual cosa hauria originat la soca prototròfica.

És vàlida l’especulació de Lederberg i Tatum l’any 1946? Raoneu la resposta.

2. Lederberg i Tatum, en l’experiment descrit a l’apartat anterior, havien descobert un nou mecanisme de transferència horitzontal de gens entre bacteris. Com que llavors ja es coneixia el mecanisme de la transformació, el 1950 Bernard Davis va dissenyar un experiment amb les soques d’E. coli usades per Lederberg i Tatum per descartar que els resultats d’aquests autors fossin deguts a la transformació.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/catpau-2023-1-5-fig1.png

A la base d’un tub en forma de U, Davis hi va col·locar un filtre que permetia el pas del medi i de les partícules que hi havia dissoltes, però no dels bacteris. En un costat del tub, hi va col·locar els bacteris de la soca A i, a l’altre, els de la soca B. A continuació, amb un sistema de pressió/succió movia el medi a través del filtre per tot el tub. Després va sembrar bacteris dels dos costats en un medi mínim i va comprovar que no hi creixien.

b) Read the following text:

Plants do not transport free glucose and fructose directly through the phloem because this transport is slow and, in addition, free glucose and free fructose are less stable than sucrose. This can be checked with the Fehling test. When the Fehling test is carried out on a solution of free glucose or on a solution of free fructose, the hemiacetal bond responsible for the cyclisation breaks and the aldehyde group in the case of glucose or the ketone group in the case of fructose are left free. When the solution is heated, the aldehyde group or the ketone group are oxidised and release electrons. These electrons reduce the $\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}$ of the Fehling reagent to $\mathrm{Cu^{+}}$, which reacts with the $\mathrm{O_2}$ of the air, which gives it the characteristic red colour. 2. The RTS,S vaccine is produced in genetically modified yeasts so that they synthesise two proteins inside them: RTS proteins and isolated S proteins.

RTS proteins have three segments of different origins:

— Segment R is the antigenic part of a protein of the sporozoite of Plasmodium falciparum.

— Segment T is another part of the sporozoite protein that allows Th lymphocytes to bind to it.

— Segment S is the same S protein (an antigen of the hepatitis B virus) attached to the other two segments.

On the other hand, the isolated S proteins assemble spontaneously inside the yeast and form empty particles of the hepatitis B virus. These particles serve for RTS proteins to be integrated into them thanks to their S segment. In this way the RTS,S particles that make up the malaria vaccine are formed.

problems.problem_orig:
El 6 d’octubre de 2021, després de dècades de recerca, l’Organització Mundial de la Salut (OMS) va aprovar la primera vacuna contra la malària, anomenada RTS,S. La malària és causada pel paràsit Plasmodium falciparum i és responsable d’unes 400 000 morts anuals. Plasmodium falciparum s’encomana a través de la picada de mosquits del gènere Anopheles i passa per diverses fases durant el seu cicle vital. La vacuna va dirigida contra la fase anomenada esporozoït, que és la forma que adopta el paràsit quan penetra a la sang d’un ésser humà.

1. Observeu la fotografia següent d’un microscopi òptic i el dibuix de l’esporozoït de Plasmodium falciparum, i responeu a les qüestions que hi ha a continuació: [1 punt]

[Figura no reproduïda (font de tercers): Fotografia al microscopi òptic, en blanc i negre, amb un esporozoït de Plasmodium falciparum, una cèl·lula fosca, allargada i fusiforme amb punts foscos a l’interior, voltada de diverses cèl·lules sanguínies rodones i grises més grans (amb una fletxa que va de l’esporozoït fotografiat al dibuix). L’esporozoït de la fotografia fa uns 100 píxels d’un total de 910 píxels d’amplada de la pàgina, és a dir, aproximadament 2,3 cm en l’exemplar imprès en paper A4 (la mesura s’ha de fer sobre la figura impresa). A la dreta, un dibuix esquemàtic en línies negres del mateix esporozoït, molt més gran: cèl·lula allargada, amb un extrem més ample i l’altre afilat, que conté un nucli gran i oval, una estructura amb crestes semblant a un mitocondri, orgànuls de membrana i fibres allargades. Llegendes impreses: «Esporozoït de Plasmodium falciparum al microscopi òptic.» i «Dibuix de l’esporozoït de Plasmodium falciparum.»]

Font: https://pixnio.com.

a) La llargària real de l’esporozoït són 15 micròmetres. Quants augments té la fotografia del microscopi òptic? Indiqueu els càlculs que heu fet.

b) En observar la fotografia, un alumne diu: «Per la seva forma allargada es pot deduir que el bacteri causant de la malària és un bacil.» A partir de la informació del dibuix, argumenteu si aquesta afirmació és correcta o no.

2. La vacuna RTS,S es fabrica en llevats modificats genèticament perquè sintetitzin en el seu interior dues proteïnes: proteïnes RTS i proteïnes S aïllades.

Les proteïnes RTS tenen tres segments de diferents orígens:

— El segment R és la part antigènica d’una proteïna de l’esporozoït de Plasmodium falciparum.

— El segment T és una altra part de la proteïna de l’esporozoït que permet que s’hi uneixin els limfòcits Th.

— El segment S és la mateixa proteïna S (un antigen del virus de l’hepatitis B) enganxada als altres dos segments.

D’altra banda, les proteïnes S aïllades s’acoblen espontàniament dins del llevat i formen partícules buides del virus de l’hepatitis B. Aquestes partícules serveixen perquè s’hi integrin proteïnes RTS gràcies al seu segment S. Així es formen les partícules RTS,S que constitueixen la vacuna contra la malària.

A partir d’aquesta informació, expliqueu el procés immunològic que es produirà en els vacunats, des del moment de la injecció de la vacuna, per a conferir-los immunitat contra la malària. [1 punt]

Octopuses are poikilothermic animals; that is, they cannot regulate their temperature and depend on the temperature of the environment. [2.5 marks in total]

In response to a drop in temperature, the California two-spot octopus (Octopus bimaculoides) deaminates some adenines of the mRNA and transforms them into guanines. This process, called deamination, takes place once the mRNA has been synthesised. This change in the mRNA sequence allows it to live at colder temperatures.

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): Black-and-white photograph of an octopus on the sea floor.]

Octopus bimaculoides. Source: Flickr.

b) SMA is caused by an alteration of the survival motor neuron 1 (SMN1) gene. This gene codes for the SMN protein, whose recessive variant a causes the synthesis of a non-functional protein.

Besides the SMN1 gene, there is another gene, called SMN2, which makes a small amount of SMN protein. The SMN2 gene, in any individual, can be repeated up to eight times and is considered to be a modifier of the characteristics of the disease, because the more copies an individual has, the less severe SMA is: three copies produce a mild phenotype of the disease and from five onwards the individual does not show the disease.

problems.problem:
Avian coccidiosis is a disease caused by different species of parasitic protozoa of the genus Eimeria, which can affect hens. [2.5 marks in total]

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/catpau-2025-3-2-fig1.png

Source: Own elaboration.

It is transmitted by ingestion of contaminated excrement. After ingestion, the parasite goes through a complex life cycle inside the hen’s intestinal tract, during which it reproduces and breaks the intestinal cells. The infected animal then eliminates oocysts (eggs of the parasites) in its faeces.

The symptoms of coccidiosis are diarrhoea, weight loss and a drop in egg laying because of the destruction of the intestinal epithelium and the alteration of nutrient absorption.

a) After scraping different areas of the intestinal mucosa of a sick hen, oocysts like the one shown in the following light microscopy image are observed only in the uppermost part of the intestine.

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): Light micrograph of a single oval oocyst (egg-shaped, with one more pointed end) with granular contents inside, on a light grey background. Two crossed black straight lines cross the oocyst: one along the long axis (labelled “Llargària”, length, at the lower end) and another across the short axis (labelled “Amplària”, width, on the right). In the lower left there is a black scale bar with the text “10 µm”. Relative sizes on the image: the length line is about 3.0 times the length of the scale bar and the width line about 2.0 times; in the printed exam the scale bar is about 16 mm long.]

Source: Biopharm.

Calculate the dimensions of the oocyst seen in the image (width × length). Show the calculations you have made. [0.5 marks]

b) To determine which species is causing the disease the following key is used. It is known that each species of the genus Eimeria invades a specific segment of the intestine and that the size of the oocysts varies between species.

In the location row, each column has a drawing of the bird’s intestine (folded small intestine with two caeca at the end) with the affected region shaded dark: E. acervulina, the upper part (first loops); E. brunetti, the final part (caeca and terminal region); E. maxima, the middle part; E. mitis, the middle part; E. necatrix, the middle part; E. praecox, the upper part; E. tenella, the caeca. Source: Table adapted from Long and Reid (1982).

Keeping the henhouse with a thick, dry layer of substrate effectively dilutes the hens’ faecal material. In this way, the hens ingest a very small number of oocysts when they peck. Consuming a small number of oocysts is not enough to cause the disease; moreover, it helps to create immunity against the disease caused by the species of coccidium ingested.

problems.problem:
In September 2020, in an article in the Boletín de la Sociedad Española de Biología Evolutiva, the researcher Carles Lalueza-Fox reviewed the latest contributions of palaeogenomics, specifically in the study of the genome in fossil remains of modern humans, Neanderthals and Denisovans. [2.5 marks in total]

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): Digital illustration of three human skulls seen in profile on a black background, labelled “Modern Human”, “Neanderthal” and “Denisovan”.]

Source: https://thevarsity.ca/2018/09/22/researchers-identify-a-neanderthal-denisovan-hybrid/.

a) These three groups of humans coexisted in time. The comparison of their genomes has shown that those of non-African modern humans contained between 2 and 2.5 % of Neanderthal genes and that those of modern humans from Oceania had 4.5 % of Denisovan genes.

Taking into account the biological species concept, assess whether it is correct to refer to these three groups of humans (modern, Neanderthals and Denisovans) as different species. Justify your answer. [0.5 marks]

b) Modern humans arose in East Africa and from there spread to other continents where Neanderthals and Denisovans already lived. Some time later, modern humans ended up displacing the Neanderthals and Denisovans. What advantage may crossing with Neanderthals and Denisovans have represented for the modern humans who arrived in Asia and Europe? [0.5 marks]

c) The study of fossil DNA of Denisovans and Neanderthals has shown relatively high frequencies of several deleterious mutations in homozygosis due to a high rate of inbreeding. What is inbreeding and why does it cause this effect? [0.5 marks]

d) Palaeogenomic studies have revealed that, among the deleterious mutations present in Neanderthals at a relatively high frequency, there were some that caused skeletal alterations.

Calculate the genotypic and phenotypic proportions of the offspring of a cross between two healthy Neanderthal individuals who are heterozygous for an autosomal gene that causes skeletal alterations. Show the calculations you have made. [0.5 marks]

e) The state of preservation of DNA in fossil samples can be a limiting factor for palaeogenomic studies. Although there is no fixed time limit, since it depends on the temperature at which the fossil has been preserved, samples older than 0.5 million years (Ma) can hardly be analysed. By contrast, it has been seen that some proteins can be preserved for more than 2 Ma. According to the author of this article, palaeoproteomics (the study of proteins from fossil remains) would allow the study of the genomes of more primitive hominids.

Explain how, starting from the obtaining of proteins from fossil remains, the sequence of the genes that code for these proteins can be determined, and detail the steps. [0.5 marks]

problems.problem:
Richard Peto is a British statistician and epidemiologist who in 1977 noted that there was a lack of correlation between the size of some animal species and the risk of developing cancer. He observed that large, long-lived species (that live for many years), such as elephants, have a cancer rate equal to or lower than that of smaller species, such as mice. This observation is known as Peto’s paradox and suggests the existence of different natural anticancer mechanisms in species.

2.1. Since cancer is related to the cell cycle, Dr Peto expected to find a higher cancer rate in animal species of larger size and longer lifespan. Answer the following questions on this matter: [0.5 marks]

What is the relationship between cancer and the cell cycle?

Why did Dr Peto expect to find a higher cancer rate in animal species of larger size and longer lifespan?

2.2. In later research it was observed that elephants do not have a higher risk of developing cancer because, in their case, molecular mechanisms that have reduced this vulnerability have been selected for from an evolutionary point of view. Elephants have twenty copies of the tumour suppressor gene TP53 in their genome, whereas humans or other mammals have one. The TP53 gene encodes the p53 protein, which stops cell division at the $\mathrm{G_2}$/M checkpoint if there is DNA damage, so that it can be repaired or, otherwise, induce apoptosis.

Explain two reasons why having twenty copies of the TP53 gene can reduce the risk of developing cancer compared with having fewer copies. [0.5 marks]

2.3. To study the role of the p53 protein in the control of the cell cycle, an experiment was carried out in the laboratory with two human cell lines: an original cell line (with a functional TP53 gene) and a cell line in which the TP53 gene had been inactivated. The two cell lines were cultured and exposed to gamma radiation, a strong ionising radiation that causes severe damage to DNA. Afterwards, each cell line was observed under the microscope and its mitotic index (the percentage of cells that were in mitosis) was calculated every twelve hours for four days.

The following results were obtained:

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): line graph. Horizontal axis: “Time after radiation (h)”, with ticks at 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84 and 96. Vertical axis: “Mitotic index (%)”, from 0 to 15. Two series of points: white squares joined by a dotted line, and black squares joined by a solid line. White squares (approximate values): 3 at 0 h, 2.5 at 12 h, 3 at 24 h, 4 at 36 h, 13 at 48 h (maximum), 9 at 60 h, 5 at 72 h, 3 at 84 h, 2 at 96 h. Black squares (approximate values): 3 at 0 h, 0 at 12, 24 and 36 h, 0.3 at 48 h, 0.6 at 60 h, 0 at 72 h, 0.3 at 84 h and 0.3 at 96 h.]

Which of the two lines on the graph (the one with white squares or the one with black squares) represents the original cell line with the functional TP53 gene? Justify your answer. [0.5 marks]

2.4. Currently, the main cause of death of young elephants in the world is infection by the elephant endotheliotropic herpesvirus (EEHV), a double-stranded DNA virus capable of causing fatal internal haemorrhages. The main reservoir of the EEHV virus is infected adult animals that do not show haemorrhages and in which the virus is in a latent phase. To identify these animals, a PCR (polymerase chain reaction) is carried out on tissue samples from the animal, together with a detection of antibodies against EEHV in blood.

Answer the following questions, in relation to this experiment. [0.5 marks]

Is it possible to find an amplification of the EEHV genome by PCR in infected adult elephants that do not show haemorrhages?

Justification:

The results are promising and show how the vaccine induced the response of two key types of immune cells: CD4+ helper T lymphocytes and CD8+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes.

Answer the following questions on vaccination. [0.5 marks]

B: Artificial / Natural

RNA vaccination consists of injecting certain mRNAs so that the elephant’s cells translate them and synthesise viral proteins. Why will these proteins activate the elephant’s immune system?

Els elefants tenen vint còpies del gen supressor de tumors TP53 en el seu genoma, mentre que els humans o altres mamífers en tenen una. In 2024 a research team from Stanford University published in the journal Cell the discovery of a new type of biological entity made of RNA: obelisks. Although obelisks were initially found in the cytosol of bacteria of the human gut microbiota, later studies have also found them in marine and environmental samples. This suggests that they are quite widespread among the bacteria of many ecosystems.

4.1. Obelisks are small molecules of single-stranded circular RNA (that is, of a single chain) with a very stable structure and an elongated shape (hence their name). Look at the following image and complete the table below. [0.5 marks]

[Figure not reproduced (third-party source): diagram titled “Estructura d’un obelisc (RNA circular d’aspecte allargat)” (Structure of an obelisk (circular RNA of elongated appearance)). On the left, a drawing of a long, thin rod-shaped molecule, with an arrow labelled “Ampliació” (Magnification) pointing to an enlarged box. In the box two paired RNA strands are shown, with ribose-phosphate backbones on either side and facing nitrogenous bases joined by dotted lines. The left strand starts at the top with “5′ Fosfat” (5′ phosphate) and ends at the bottom with “3′ OH”; the right strand starts at the bottom with “5′ Fosfat” and ends at the top with “3′ OH”. The three base pairs, from top to bottom, are: a base marked with the letter X (six-membered ring with two C=O groups and one N–H) facing an A, with two dotted lines between them; a C facing a G, with three dotted lines; and another X facing an A. The left-hand nucleotide of the C–G pair (phosphate, sugar and base C) is circled and marked with the number 1. The sugar (pentose) at the end of the left strand, at the bottom, next to “3′ OH”, is circled and marked with the number 2. Two dotted lines between the X and the A of the lower pair are indicated with the number 3. At the top right there is a small drawing of an Egyptian obelisk with the text “Obelisc egipci. Font: Wikimedia Commons.” (Egyptian obelisk. Source: Wikimedia Commons.)]

Source: Image modified from the article by Ivan N. Zheludev et al. “Viroid-like colonists of human microbiomes”. Cell (14 November 2024).

L’any 2024 un equip de recerca de la Universitat de Stanford va publicar a la revista Cell el descobriment d’un nou tipus d’entitat biològica feta d’RNA: els obeliscs. Tot i que els obeliscs es van trobar inicialment al citosol de bacteris de la microbiota digestiva humana, estudis posteriors n’han trobat també en mostres marines i ambientals. Aquest fet suggereix que estan bastant estesos entre els bacteris de molts ecosistemes.

4.1. Els obeliscs són petites molècules d’RNA circular monocatenari (és a dir, de cadena senzilla) amb una estructura molt estable i una forma allargada (d’aquí els ve el nom). Observeu la imatge següent i completeu la taula que hi ha a continuació. [0,5 punts]

En el requadre es veuen dues cadenes d’RNA aparellades, amb els esquelets de ribosa i fosfat a banda i banda i bases nitrogenades enfrontades, unides per línies de punts. La cadena de l’esquerra comença dalt amb «5′ Fosfat» i acaba baix amb «3′ OH»; la de la dreta comença baix amb «5′ Fosfat» i acaba dalt amb «3′ OH». Els tres parells de bases, de dalt a baix, són: una base marcada amb la lletra X (anell de sis àtoms amb dos grups C=O i un N–H) enfrontada a una A, amb dues línies de punts entre elles; una C enfrontada a una G, amb tres línies de punts; i una altra X enfrontada a una A. El nucleòtid de l’esquerra del parell C–G (fosfat, sucre i base C) està encerclat i marcat amb el número 1. El sucre (pentosa) del final de la cadena de l’esquerra, a baix, al costat de «3′ OH», està encerclat i marcat amb el número 2.
